review_note: Independent gold review: read REVIEW-BRIEF.md, AUTHOR-BRIEF.md, items-author.json, all 13 workflows/*.yaml and the relevant parts of scripts/workflow_registry.py (CONDOR one-community note, per-group/per-time-point claim texts, the no-prediction text, PANDA controls).
